subject: Lesotho
note: Hand-curated research for the second Geographica episode (#74). Claims are cited to pinned Wikipedia revisions (trusted_secondary: state plainly and precisely). Map geometry is drawn from Natural Earth and is not evidence for any of these claims.

claims.text: Lesotho is a landlocked country completely surrounded by South Africa.
Lesotho is the largest of the world's three independent states completely surrounded by another country; the other two, Vatican City and San Marino, are surrounded by Italy.
Lesotho is the only independent state that lies entirely above 1,000 metres in elevation.
Its lowest point, 1,400 metres, is the highest lowest point of any country in the world.
Over 80% of Lesotho lies above 1,800 metres.
Thabana Ntlenyana, in Lesotho's Maloti Mountains, is the highest mountain in southern Africa at 3,482 metres.
Lesotho's capital and largest city is Maseru.

maseru.note: Capital of Lesotho, on the western border with South Africa.

thabana-ntlenyana.note: Summit of the highest mountain in southern Africa.
